integrity: A complete analytic proof and reproducible finite checks are supplied. The finite tests are not substituted for infinite proofs. No authorship, public priority, independent certification or broader generality is asserted.
scientific_limitations: One fixed centered power cusp on [0,1], uniform mesh and independent complementary samples within each cell, exponents 0<gamma<=2; not a result for general irrational cusp locations, arbitrary meshes or pathwise cross-grid couplings.
title: A cusp-phase limit-law transition for antithetic randomised trapezoidal quadrature
